verdict.rationale: Dropbox's developer platform page lists 'previews' as one of the features the DBX Platform provides alongside storage, sharing, and search, implying an API-driven preview/thumbnail capability, but no evidence pack item names specific endpoints (e.g., get_thumbnail/get_preview), supported formats, or embeddable preview usage. Missing for 10: documented thumbnail/preview API reference, supported file-format list, code samples showing preview retrieval without client-side rendering, and independent confirmation of this feature working.
